T: A family secret and a wedding banquet.
D: A Chinese-American woman travels to China, where her family has organised a fake wedding to say goodbye to their grandmother.
P: Serve the main at the wedding banquet.
S: Pork, wombok and ginger dumplings pan-fried until crisp underneath

Pork, cabbage and ginger dumplings pan-fried until crisp on the bottom, with a black vinegar, soy and chilli oil dipping sauce. Salt 200g finely chopped wombok for 10 minutes and squeeze dry. Mix with 400g pork mince, 1 tbsp grated ginger, 2 sliced spring onions, 2 tbsp soy and 1 tsp sesame oil. Fill 30 round dumpling wrappers, wet the edges and pleat closed. Fry in 2 tbsp oil for 2 minutes until golden underneath, add 100ml water, cover and steam 6 minutes until dry. Mix 3 tbsp black vinegar, 1 tbsp soy and 1 tbsp chilli oil for dipping.
Changchun smashed cucumber with chilli oil
Smashed cucumber in garlic, black vinegar and chilli oil dressing

Cold smashed cucumbers in a punchy dressing of garlic, black vinegar, soy and chilli oil, topped with toasted sesame and coriander. Lay 4 Lebanese cucumbers on a board and smash with the flat of a knife until they split, then cut into bite-size chunks. Toss with 1 tsp salt and 1 tsp sugar and drain in a sieve for 15 minutes. Mix 3 crushed garlic cloves, 2 tbsp black vinegar, 1 tbsp soy, 1 tsp sesame oil and 2 tbsp chilli oil. Toss the cucumbers in the dressing and top with toasted sesame seeds and coriander.
M: Wedding banquet crispy sweet and sour pork
Twice-fried pork with capsicum and pineapple in sweet and sour sauce

Northeast Chinese style crispy pork in a glossy tangy sauce with capsicum, pineapple and carrot, served with steamed jasmine rice. Cut 600g pork scotch fillet into thin slices, season and toss in 1 egg white, then in 100g potato starch. Fry at 180C for 3 minutes, rest, then fry again for 1 minute until very crisp. Stir-fry 1 capsicum, 1 julienned carrot, 2 garlic cloves and 150g pineapple chunks for 2 minutes. Add 4 tbsp rice vinegar, 4 tbsp sugar, 3 tbsp tomato sauce, 1 tbsp soy and 1 tsp cornflour in 60ml water and bubble until glossy. Toss in the pork and serve with 300g rice.
Banquet steamed fish with ginger and spring onion
A whole fish at the wedding banquet, so Nai Nai has plenty ahead
Whole snapper steamed over ginger, then dressed with soy and a splash of sizzling oil over shredded spring onion and coriander.
W: Fried glutinous rice balls filled with sweet red bean paste

Chewy glutinous rice balls filled with sweet red bean paste, rolled in sesame seeds and fried until puffed, golden and crisp. Mix 250g glutinous rice flour with 60g caster sugar, then stir in about 200ml hot water and knead to a smooth, soft dough. Divide into 16 balls. Flatten each, fill with 1 tsp red bean paste from a 200g tin and roll closed. Wet lightly and roll in 80g white sesame seeds. Fry in oil at 160C for 6 to 8 minutes, pressing gently against the side of the pot so they puff, until golden.
K: Nai Nai's iced jasmine lychee tea
Chilled jasmine tea with lychees and a squeeze of lime

Fragrant jasmine tea brewed gently, chilled with lychee syrup and lime and served over ice with whole lychees. Steep 4 jasmine tea bags in 1L water just off the boil for 3 minutes, then remove the bags and cool. Drain a 565g tin of lychees, keeping 150ml syrup. Stir the syrup and the juice of 1 lime into the tea and chill. Fill 4 glasses with ice and a few lychees and pour over the tea.

Fry in oil until golden underneath.
Add water, cover and steam until dry.

veg.n: Nai Nai's pan-fried mushroom and tofu dumplings
veg.make_ahead: Filling up to 1 day ahead, fill and fry fresh

steps.text: Finely chop the wombok, salt it and leave for 10 minutes, then squeeze dry.
Finely chop the mushrooms, crumble the tofu and mix with the wombok, grated ginger, spring onions, most of the soy and the sesame oil.
Fill the dumpling wrappers, wet the edges and pleat closed.
Fry in the vegetable oil until golden underneath.
Add water, cover and steam until dry.
Mix the black vinegar, the rest of the soy and chilli oil for dipping.

dishes.n: Changchun smashed cucumber with chilli oil

steps.text: Smash the cucumbers with the flat of a knife until they split, then cut into bite-size chunks.
Toss with salt and sugar.
Drain in a sieve for 15 minutes.
Mix the crushed garlic, black vinegar, soy, sesame oil and chilli oil.
Toss the cucumbers in the dressing and top with toasted sesame seeds and coriander.

dishes.n: Wedding banquet crispy sweet and sour pork
dishes.make_ahead: Eat straight away for the best crunch

steps.text: Slice the pork thinly, season and toss in egg white, then potato starch.
Heat the oil to 180C and fry the pork in batches, then rest.
Fry again in the oil until very crisp.
Julienne the carrot and slice the capsicum and garlic.
Stir-fry the capsicum, carrot, garlic and pineapple.
Mix the rice vinegar, sugar, tomato sauce, soy and cornflour with water.
Add the sauce and bubble until glossy.
Cook the rice.
Toss in the pork and serve with rice.

veg.n: Wedding banquet crispy sweet and sour tofu
veg.make_ahead: Eat straight away for the best crunch

steps.text: Pat the tofu dry, cut into bite size pieces and toss in the egg white, then the potato starch.
Cook the rice.
Fry the tofu in the oil at 180C, rest it, then fry again until very crisp.
Julienne the carrot, slice the capsicum and garlic and stir-fry with the pineapple in 1 tbsp of the oil.
Mix the rice vinegar, sugar, tomato sauce, soy and cornflour with the water, add to the wok and bubble until glossy.
Toss in the tofu and serve with the rice.

dishes.n: Banquet steamed fish with ginger and spring onion
dishes.make_ahead: Shred the ginger and spring onion up to 4 hours ahead; steam the fish just before serving

steps.text: Score the fish twice on each side and lay on a plate on half the ginger.
Steam over rapidly boiling water until the flesh at the thickest part flakes.
Warm the soy with the sugar and 2 tbsp water. Pour off the steaming liquid and spoon the soy over the fish.
Pile the rest of the ginger, the spring onion and coriander on top. Heat the oil until smoking and pour it over so it sizzles.

veg.n: Banquet steamed tofu with ginger and spring onion
veg.make_ahead: Shred the ginger and spring onion up to 4 hours ahead; steam on the night

steps.text: Slide the tofu onto a plate and steam until hot through.
Warm the soy with the sugar and water and spoon over. Pile on the ginger, spring onion and coriander.
Heat the oil until smoking and pour it over so it sizzles.

dishes.make_ahead: Dough up to 2 hours ahead, fry fresh

steps.text: Mix the rice flour with sugar, stir in hot water and knead to a smooth, soft dough.
Divide into balls, flatten each, fill with red bean paste and roll closed.
Wet lightly and roll in sesame seeds.
Fry in oil at 160C, pressing gently against the side of the pot so they puff, until golden.

dishes.n: Nai Nai's iced jasmine lychee tea

steps.text: Steep the jasmine tea bags in water just off the boil.
Leave for 3 minutes, then remove the bags and cool.
Drain the lychees, keeping some syrup.
Stir the syrup and lime juice into the tea.
Chill until cold.
Fill glasses with ice and a few lychees and pour over the tea.
